title: WebSockets, Server-Sent Events, and Realtime State Check

questions.prompt: Which protocol naturally fits one-way server event streaming?
questions.explanation: SSE is an HTTP server-to-client event stream with event identity and retry concepts.

questions.prompt: A live WebSocket should be treated as durable authoritative storage.
questions.explanation: Connections drop and replay; authoritative state must be reconciled elsewhere.

questions.prompt: How should a callbackFlow release its listener?
questions.explanation: Collector cancellation then performs symmetrical cleanup.
